notebookEntry.result:
Protein Builder cloning assembly design

Construct: Protein Builder Insert
Backbone: Promoter-aligned backbone
Assembled construct length: 3,825 bp
Recommended route: Gibson assembly
Primer threshold: strict

PCR program
Polymerase: High-fidelity DNA polymerase
Longest PCR target: 3,429 bp
- Initial denaturation: 98 C, 30 s, 1 cycle
- Denaturation: 98 C, 10 s, 30 cycles
- Annealing: 57 C, 20 s, 30 cycles
- Extension: 72 C, 1 min 45 s, 30 cycles
- Final extension: 72 C, 2 min, 1 cycle
- Hold: 4 C, hold, 1 cycle
- Annealing temperature is estimated from the lowest primer binding Tm (59.9 C) minus 3 C.
- Extension is estimated at 30 s/kb for the longest planned PCR target (3,429 bp). Adjust to the polymerase data sheet.

Primers
- Promoter-aligned backbone_F; role: Assembly Forward Start; sequence: GGATCTGCGATCGCTCCGGTG; length: 21 nt; Tm: 60.2 C; GC: 66.7%
- Promoter-aligned backbone_R; role: Assembly Reverse Overlap; sequence: CACCACCACCACCACCACGAAAACCTGTTCGATAGAGAAATGTTCTGGCACCTGC; length: 55 nt; Tm: 59.9 C; GC: 52.7%; notes: Carries a 27 nt overlap into Protein Builder Insert.
- Protein Builder Insert_F; role: Assembly Forward; sequence: CACCACCACCACCACCACGAAAAC; length: 24 nt; Tm: 60.8 C; GC: 58.3%
- Protein Builder Insert_R; role: Assembly Reverse Overlap; sequence: GGATCTGCGATCGCTCCGGTGCCATACGGGGCATTCACTTTCACGGTGATAC; length: 52 nt; Tm: 61.5 C; GC: 57.7%; notes: Carries a 23 nt overlap into Promoter-aligned backbone.

Assembly procedure
1. Amplify fragments: PCR-amplify all fragments using the overlap-bearing primer set.
2. Assemble reaction: Combine fragments in a Gibson-style assembly reaction using the planned overlap order.
3. Transform and recover: Transform the assembly reaction into competent cells and recover colonies.
4. Validate junctions: Screen every junction by colony PCR and sequence through the assembled insert.

Validation plan
- colony-pcr, all designed assembly junctions: Confirm that every overlap assembled as planned.
- sanger-sequencing, assembled insert and adjacent backbone sequence: Verify seamless junction formation.

Warnings
- No terminal overlap is present; a primer-introduced overlap is required.
- No supported edit request was provided.
